title: English Time & Tense PDF Imported Question Bank
subject: English

questions.q: The best thing about your father is that he is always taking life with a positive attitude. Find out the error.
options: The best thing about your father is that
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: Use simple present 'takes' for habitual actions.

questions.q: You are coming so late sometimes that it becomes very difficult for me to manage such a huge number of students.
options: very difficult for me to manage
such a huge number of students.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: Use simple present 'come' for habits indicated by 'sometimes'.

questions.q: I go to the office only twice a week these days because I have got to supervise the on-going construction work.
options: I go to the office only
because I have got to supervise
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'these days' indicates temporary situation, use present continuous 'am going'.

questions.q: My mother goes out for a morning walk everyday because the doctor has advised her to do so.
options: My mother goes out for a morning
to do so if she really wants to get well soon.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'every day' (two words) is the adverbial phrase, not adjective 'everyday'.

questions.q: She is sneezing again, so I think she has a cold.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: Sneezing is momentary; use present perfect 'has sneezed' or simple present.

questions.q: I am not able to answer any of your questions because they did not give me enough information yet.
options: I am not able to answer
information or data on it yet.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: You always come late and now I am not going to tolerate it any more.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: Use present continuous with 'always' to show annoyance: 'are always coming'.

questions.q: People know that India can be a superpower only when they will work honestly.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: Time clauses with 'when' take simple present 'work', not future.

questions.q: Unless they come up and do not take up the responsibility of taking care of these pets, I cannot think of going away.
options: and do not take up the responsibility
of taking care of these pets,
I cannot think of going away.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Unless' is already negative; 'do not' creates a double negative.
